newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds price firm on dlr/Chicago.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds price firm on dlr/Chicago.

text.p: Higher Chicago futures on weather concerns and a strong dollar underpinned UK meals and feeds prices on Wednesday.
Brokers reported a lot of interest but little if any of it was turned into business.
"People are getting a bit worried by Chicago and currency, but at the moment they are not buying," said one broker.
High protein soymeal was as much as three stg higher from the mill while stores were 1.50 to 4.50 stg up.
Rapemeal was mixed with sellers ranging from one stg down to one stg up while sunflower pellets and meals were one stg higher.
